customManagers.description: Surface a published OpenBao plugin version that apps/secret has not pinned yet. Renovate manages the `version` ONLY — it cannot compute `sha256`, which is the checksum of the plugin BINARY inside the image rather than the image's manifest digest, and a tag moved without its checksum makes OpenBao reject the registration with a bare 'checksum mismatch'. `moon run release:self_upgrade` is what actually writes both together after a publish; this manager exists so a human can see when that has not happened.

packageRules.description: Dependency updates to the released OpenBao plugins must be releasable. These two directories are release-please packages whose published versions are immutable, so a change typed with the repo-global `chore` would alter the shipped image (both run on `FROM alpine`) without producing a version bump — and the registry guard in release.sh would then correctly refuse to re-push the existing tag, leaving base-image CVE fixes permanently unpublished. `fix` makes them ship. Note the automerge rule above still does not apply to these 0.x packages, so their PRs land by hand.
